what: Solana signatures recorded from emulated hardware wallets (Trezor Safe 5 emulator, Ledger Flex and Nano S Plus on Speculos), public test seeds only; frozen test vectors of the sol_ed25519 arm
notes: Every positive is an off-chain message v1 the device signed: ff "solana offchain" 01 01, the signing key, then the text (signed = that head and the text).
Approval texts are corpus texts that name a corpus key, not the signer: they are checked on the circuit path by contracts/probe-sol-ed25519-fixtures.compact, not by the arm circuits.
Blind rows sign the device blind request (src/wallet/blind.ts) for the signing key; blind = SHA-256(pad32("midnight:account:blind:sol:v1") || signature).
Negatives are off-chain messages v0 of approval texts, signed by the device: refused in both formats.
